title: Archive rooms on the wire: the Archived and Sent pushes
spec: FEATURE_ARCHIVE (32). Push 73 Archived { room, cursor 0 } and push 74 Sent { room, cursor, sent_ms }; neither advances the cursor. After a successful Sync of an archive room, a connection that agreed to FEATURE_ARCHIVE sends Archived before the room's events, and Sent after the Posted push of each imported message (DurableServer::imported_sent_ms); a connection without the feature, and every ordinary room, gets neither. The client inbox keeps the flag (RoomView::archived) and the times (RoomView::sent_times). The network server advertises FEATURE_ARCHIVE.
